meta.title: Restaurant menus with personality
meta.description: A QR menu with your restaurant’s personality: five designs, animated mascots, a mini game and an easy way to choose dishes. Create yours with Milestis.

hero.title: A menu with
hero.description: Show off your dishes, introduce a tiny host and make choosing dinner a lovely part of the evening.
hero.audience: For cosy cafés, lively bistros and restaurants with a taste of their own.

studio.sticker: Yes, you can play with me!
studio.label: Your menu’s little host
studio.caption: Try the buttons. This is a live demo.

styles.title: Your taste. Your menu.
styles.description: Quiet elegance or a bold statement? Pick a starting point, choose colours and fonts, and add photos of your dishes.

templates.menu-pulse: Bold accents and plenty of energy.

features.title: Less explaining. More exploring.
features.description: Guests explore your food at their own pace. You update the menu whenever your restaurant needs it.

qr.title: Scan. Open. Choose.
qr.description: Your menu opens in a phone browser. Share a link or download a QR code for the table. No app required.

selection.title: “This one. And that one.”
selection.description: Guests build a list, adjust quantities and see the total. When they’re ready, they can show their selection to the waiter.

updates.title: New dish? On the menu.
updates.description: Change a price, add a seasonal special or hide a dish. Select “Update menu” and keep the same address and QR code.

features.note: Give breakfast, drinks and dinner their own pages. Guests switch between them without a full page reload.

character.title: A tiny host. A reason to smile.
character.description: Bun, Mochi and Pepper greet guests and react to their choices. While waiting, guests can match treats in a mini game and raise their character’s interest. Prefer a quieter menu? You can turn the mascot off.

create.title: Choose Menu mode
create.description: Create a project in your dashboard and find a design that feels like your restaurant.

fill.title: Bring your dishes together
fill.description: Add categories, dishes, prices and photos. Mark the dishes you recommend trying.

share.title: Publish and welcome your guests
share.description: Choose an address, get your QR code and place it on your tables. Edit your published menu from Archive.

app.question: Do guests need to install anything?
app.answer: No. They open the menu in a browser using a link or QR code. Browsing, choosing dishes and playing do not require an account.

qr.question: Do I need a new QR code after every update?
qr.answer: No. Update your existing project and its address stays the same. Use the menu’s home page for the QR code on your tables.

order.question: Are selections sent straight to the kitchen?
order.answer: No. For now, it’s a handy list with quantities and a total that guests can show to a waiter. Sending orders to the kitchen and taking payments are not included.

end.title: Make your menu memorable.
end.description: Your dishes. Your personality. We’ve made a place for your guests to discover both.
